spans.s: gilāna, ˚naka (= Pali, both; Skt. glāna, BHS glāna and glānaka), weak, exhausted, sick: ˚na LV 〔189.19〕; Mv 〔i.117.7〕; 〔ii.153.19〕 (prose); ˚na-bhaiṣajya SP 〔13.12〕; 〔119.10〕; 〔284.8〕; Mv 〔ii.221.5〕 ˚naka-tva, see glānaka.
gillapeṭṭa, adj., pot-pellied: Mvy 〔8889〕 = Tib. gsus ḥphyaṅ, lit. with belly hanging down, same as lambodara 〔8890〕; spelled gillapeṭha MSV 〔iv.194.8〕 (here as term of abuse).
